personality.summary: Obsessive and neglectful, yet left behind a heat of artistic passion that shaped Sara's life.

relationships.sara-bloodlily: Daughter who hated his painting for stealing him, then chose to complete it as love, filial piety and artistic challenge.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Indirect link through Kazamatsuri Kozo, who took responsibility for Sara after his death.

periods.summary: Sara remembers her father mostly as a back turned toward a huge religious painting of Armageddon. He never responded to her calls and left her care to hired help while he repeatedly painted and scraped away the central Messiah figure. After he died from illness over the unfinished canvas, Sara tried to destroy it but saw the spent paint tubes, ruined brushes and scarred blank center, realizing the grief and passion he had poured into it. She resolved to complete the painting as her one act of love and eventually, in the match against Ikki, gives her final soul-image the face she thought she had forgotten: her father's face, under the name Mario Rosso.

key_events.summary: Sara explains her father, his unfinished painting and why she seeks Ikki.
Sara's final phantom Mario Rosso bears the remembered face of her father.
